title.narrative: UNICEF enhanced the provision of basic water, sanitation and hygiene services in schools and health facilities. Furthermore, UNICEF provided new water points and upgraded 37 boreholes to solar-powered water systems, providing a resilient and sustainable water supply to more than 352,000 people (114 per cent) in institutions and communities.;
